basis: On AXT’s public Q4 2024 earnings call, CFO Gary Fischer said, “we expect Q1 revenue to be in the range of $18.0 million-$20.0 million.” The forecast covered AXT’s total Q1 2025 revenue, including substrates and raw materials. Its $20,000,000 high end was below $21,553,600, or 95% of Q1 2024 consolidated revenue of $22,688,000. This was the earliest qualifying disclosure found.

coverage.detail: The October 31, 2024 Q3 release expressed optimism about growth in 2025 but gave no Q1 2025 revenue figure.
On the October 31 call, management guided revenue to $23 million–$25 million for Q4 2024. That range applied to the quarter ending in December.

AXT announced a webcast of its January 14, 2025 Needham presentation. Management discussed product demand and market opportunities without giving a consolidated Q1 revenue range. [Conference remarks](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/axti/transcripts/305092-27th-annual-needham-growth-conference/)
The February 20 earnings release reported Q4 and fiscal 2024 results and announced the public call for 1:30 p.m. Pacific that day. The written exhibit omitted the Q1 range.

On the February 20 call, Fischer gave the $18 million–$20 million range during first-quarter guidance. He explained that the forecast included gallium arsenide growth, indium phosphide export restrictions and a decrease in raw-material revenue. The separately discussed $4 million–$5 million in delayed sales quantified only the export impact.
The March 24 corporate presentation showed historical financials through fiscal 2024 and gave no updated consolidated Q1 2025 revenue range.
The April 3 announcement scheduled results for May 1 and gave no preliminary revenue. The search found no intervening preliminary Q1 revenue release or updated guidance.

On May 1, AXT’s condensed consolidated statements of operations reported revenue of $19,356,000 and $22,688,000 for the three months ended March 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively. Both figures come from the same GAAP revenue row, presented in thousands.

publication_date_evidence: AXT’s February 20, 2025 release announced that day’s live public simulcast at 1:30 p.m. Pacific. The call transcript is dated February 20 and records Fischer giving the Q1 range. [AXT’s dated release and call details](https://investors.axt.com/Investors/news/news-details/2025/AXT-Inc.-Announces-Fourth-Quarter-and-Fiscal-Year-2024-Financial-Results/default.aspx)
